summary: Founder-led 22-staff turner (2-5 M EUR turnover); our ~EUR 317k is roughly 6-16 % of its turnover, so we matter. Second shift idle since spring, owner admits stale costing, calls us a reference customer. In P05 it answered data with 'a fair point' and moved 36 -> 30.5 -> 28 by round 3; faster payment and binding volume bought more. Open deep, feed it index, scorecard and rival data one kind per round, never change terms after its final offer.
notes: Needs work for the idle second shift and reliable cash. Grievance about overdue invoices although we pay on average 8 days early (30 % of invoices >5 days late). Quality slipping: OTD 85.7 -> 80.8 %, ppm up to 1,863, 3 open 8D. Should-cost 25.22 for part:320010 is not of its plant (price 24.37).

evidence.quote: admitted he had not followed his material and energy prices closely since the 2022 peak
they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.
We have free capacity for your parts.
said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.
Several of our invoices are overdue again. We ask you to keep to the agreed payment terms
getting the cash in … days reliably is exactly what we need.
we can always use the cash faster.
We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.
We did not know that - a fair point.

levers: more parts for the idle second shift
arguments: index change (in P05 it conceded electricity is down)
rival quote from other RFQ bidders (sup:70290 is dearer at 24.92 on the 24 mm shaft)
contract §3.1: no increase notice by 2 Oct
avoid: changing any term after its final offer (walked in P05)
accepting in round 1 (it agreed instantly at 32.57/31.51 = too much)
citing a cost driver that rose
tactics: Open deep; its first counter does not depend on our opening.
Bring one new evidence kind per round (index, scorecard, rival quote); it calls each a fair point and moves.
Offer 14-day payment and a binding volume with the schedule attached in exchange for price.
When it says it must clarify internally, hold and wait for the next round; it comes back lower.
After its final offer accept or walk; do not touch payment or lead time again.
playbook.expected_concession: In P05 first counter ~15 % below its opening, final ~22 % below by round 3 (best 27.66 vs 36.0); renewals settled ~2 pts below its ask.
